critical_code_review_comments: services/iap_revenuecat.py fulfill_pending_consumable L204-236: uses find_one_and_update with sort=[('created_at',1)] to atomically claim the OLDEST pending order for (user_id, product_id, status=pending). Correct + race-safe. Failure branch releases the claim back to pending. Good.

routes/iap.py iap_create_order L47-60: marketplace_install fetches listing with status='Published' — an unpublished listing correctly 404s. Rejects free listings (<=0) with 400 before creating an order, preventing 'stuck' orders that could never be fulfilled by any store product. Good.

routes/iap.py L57-58: marketplace_install checks ai_employee_marketplace_licenses BEFORE creating a pending order — this is correct, but the check is by workspace, so a user in the SAME workspace can create the pending order but two users concurrently tapping Install for a paid listing could BOTH create pending orders (only one webhook will fulfill; the other pending order will be stranded). Consider a unique index (workspace_id, listing_id, status='pending') to prevent this race. Not blocking; the second webhook wouldn't grant a duplicate license because install_listing_for_workspace raises 400 'Already installed' — which the fulfill branch catches and returns the claim to pending. Slight zombie-order risk only.
services/iap_revenuecat.py marketplace_product_for_price L71-75: rounds UP to the nearest tier. Uses <= comparison against ceiling floats — safe for the given tiers.
mobile/app/paywall.tsx: upsell banner + Pro card highlight verified in web preview (screenshot). Compliant — no auto-redirect out to teamnest.ai/billing on load.

mobile/app/marketplace/index.tsx L158-170 + iapConsumablesAvailable(): web-preview fallback path is correct — direct backend install for BOTH free and paid on web (so testers can complete the flow); on native, paid uses purchaseConsumableIap (pending-order + store purchase) and free uses direct install.
